description.value: Taco Bell on 73rd Avenue in Surrey is a Tex-Mex fast food franchise offering tacos, burritos, and specialty items including a dedicated Veggie Cravings Menu. The location features both a dine-in area and a drive-thru, providing flexible options for cyclists looking for a quick, affordable meal. It sits in a commercial area of Surrey and serves as a convenient resupply stop for riders passing through the city.
